atoms.text: If you want to use the words of someone else from a source, you have to put them in quotation marks. In German, you use „…“ and in English you use “…”.

atoms.text:
Studies have shown that the smartphone addiction of an average student influences their performance at school. In particular, the use of social media while studying has negative impacts. Also, skills and cognitive abilities are negatively affected.

Suzie Milano

atoms.text: A text is plagiarized when information or the exact wording are taken from it without naming it as a source. Plagiarism violates the copyright which each author has when they publish their intellectual property.

atoms.a: Plagiarism is copying without showing where the information is from.
If you use the words of someone else, you have to use quotation marks.
You don't have to name the source when you paraphrase the original text.
Plagiarism does not violate the copyright.

atoms.text:
In the last ten years the number of smartphone users in Germany has grown over 30%. Today, more than 68% of the population uses a mobile device. The numbers will likely grow further. It is predicted that by 2027, 72% of the population will have a smartphone.

Nicole Goddan
atoms.sound: In the last ten years the number of smartphone users in Germany has grown over 30%. Today, more than 68% of the population uses a mobile device. The numbers will likely grow further. It is predicted that by 2027, 72% of the population will have a smartphone.

atoms.b: The amount of people on social media has risen because more and more people use smartphones. “In the last ten years the number of smartphone users in Germany has grown over 30%,” says Nicole Goddan.
The number of smartphone users is rising. According to Nicole Goddan, it has doubled in Germany within the last 10 years.
It is possible that by 2027, 72% of the population might have a smartphone. In comparison: Today, more than 68% of the population uses the mobile device. The trend is still rising.
